tools.name: search_law
tools.description: Search the laws of the Republic of Korea (South Korea) in force by keyword (name, promulgation and effective dates). Use this first when you do not know the official law name. Korean abbreviations (근기법, 주임법) are expanded to the official name. An English query searches the official English titles and

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get the text of an article of a Korean law in force, verbatim and unedited from the Ministry of Government Legislation (법제처). The law needs its official name, in Korean or the official English title (e.g. 근로기준법, Labor Standards Act). With lang en (default for an English law name) it gives the offici

tools.name: get_law_status
tools.description: Show a Korean law's effective date in force and whether an amendment has been promulgated but is not yet in force (시행예정). If so, also lists the articles it changes and its addenda (부칙: effective dates, transitional provisions). With an English law name it answers in English and says whether the offi

tools.name: get_param
tools.description: Get a Korean legal reference value verified by Lifelaw (라이프로), such as the statutory interest rate, minimum wage or lease renewal request period, with its legal basis (article), verification date and start date of effect, labelled in Korean and English. Find keys with list_params.

tools.name: list_params
tools.description: List the available Korean legal reference values (key, name in Korean and English, unit). Can be filtered by field (key prefix).

tools.name: search_rule
tools.description: Search Korean administrative rules in force (행정규칙: notices 고시, directives 훈령, established rules 예규, guidelines 지침, etc.) by words in the rule name (type, ministry, issue and effective dates). Search terms must be in Korean. Use this first when you do not know the official rule name. Note that admini

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Get a Korean administrative rule in force. With only name: an outline (articles, annexes); with article: that article's text; with annex: the annex (별표; tables shown as text line by line). Filter a long annex with keyword or split it with page. article and annex cannot be combined. For a notice (고시)

tools.name: search_case
tools.description: Search Korean court precedents (판례) by keyword. Search terms must be in Korean. Precedents are not law: they are reference material, decisions on individual cases. Use the first number of each result (not the case number) as the id for get_case.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: Get a Korean court precedent: holdings (판시사항), summary (판결요지), referenced provisions (참조조문) and full text (판례내용). Precedents are not law: they are reference material, decisions on individual cases, and may change later. id is the number from search_case results (not the case number).

tools.name: search_interpretation
tools.description: Search Korean statutory interpretations (법령해석례: replies by the Ministry of Government Legislation and others on how laws apply) by keyword. Search terms must be in Korean. Interpretations are not law but reference material. Use the first number of each result as the id for get_interpretation.

tools.name: get_interpretation
tools.description: Get a Korean statutory interpretation: question (질의요지), answer (회답) and reasons (이유). Interpretations are not law: they are reference material, answers to individual questions, and may change later. id is the number from search_interpretation results (not the item number 안건번호).

tools.name: search_tax_tribunal
tools.description: Search decisions of Korea's Tax Tribunal (조세심판원; appeals against tax assessments) by keyword, newest decision first. Search terms must be in Korean. Decisions are not law but rulings on individual cases. Use the first number of each result (not the claim number) as the id for get_tax_tribunal.

tools.name: get_tax_tribunal
tools.description: Get a Korean Tax Tribunal decision: order (주문), claim (청구취지), summary (재결요지), related laws, referenced decisions and reasons. Decisions are not law but rulings on individual cases, and may change later. id is the number from search_tax_tribunal results (not the claim number).

tools.name: search_tax_interpretation
tools.description: Search Korean tax interpretations (advance rulings, replies to inquiries, 예규, etc.) by the National Tax Service (국세청) and the Ministry of Economy and Finance (재정경제부) by words in the title (in the body with body_search), newest first. Search terms must be in Korean. Put a result's document ID (문서ID)

tools.name: get_tax_interpretation
tools.description: Get one Korean tax interpretation by the National Tax Service or the Ministry of Economy and Finance from the NTS tax law information system (국세법령정보시스템): summary, body (facts, question, reply) and related laws. id is the document ID (문서ID) from search_tax_interpretation results, or the original link

tools.name: get_tax_basic_rule
tools.description: Get Korean tax basic rulings (기본통칙: the National Tax Service's standards for applying tax law articles) from the NTS tax law information system. tools.name: list_tax_execution_standard
tools.description: Get Korean tax enforcement standards (집행기준: the National Tax Service's compilation of the Act, Decree, basic rulings and interpretations). tools.name: search_law_by_question
tools.description: Find Korean law articles related to a question asked in a sentence (법제처 intelligent law search). The question must be in Korean, e.g. '전세 보증금을 돌려받지 못하면 어떻게 하나요'. scope 행정규칙 searches the articles of administrative rules (notices 고시, directives 훈령). tools.name: compare_law
tools.description: Compare a Korean law's articles before and after amendment (신구법), or show the Act, Enforcement Decree and Enforcement Rule side by side (3단 비교, three-tier). kind: 신구법 = old/new text of the latest amendment (changed text in 【 】); 3단 위임 = Act articles with the Decree and Rule articles they delegate to

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description:

evidence.snippet: before: "세법 집행기준(국세청이 법·시행령·통칙·해석을 묶어 정리한 기준)을 가져옵니다. law 만 주면 항목 번호·제목 목록을, item 을 주면 그 항목 본문을(국세청 발간 PDF 에서 읽음), keyword 를 주면 제목에 그 낱말이 든 항목을 줍니다. 집행기준은 법령이 아닙니다. 있는 것: 국세기본법·국세징수법·법인세·국제조세·종합소득세·양도소득세·종합부동산세·상속증여세·개별소비세·인지세·주세·주류면허법·증권거래세·부가가치세·조세특례제한법." → after: "Get Korean tax enforcement standards (집행기준: the National Tax Service's compilation of the Act, Decree, basic rulings and interpretations). With only law: item numbers and titles; with item: that item's text (read from the NTS-published PDF); with keyword: items with that word in the title. Enforceme"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

evidence.snippet: before: "법령의 개정 전후 조문(신구법) 또는 법률·시행령·시행규칙을 나란히(3단 비교) 보여 줍니다. kind: 신구법(최근 개정에서 바뀐 조문, 바뀐 글자는 【 】), 3단 위임(법률 조문과 그 위임을 받은 시행령·시행규칙 조문), 3단 인용(법률 조문을 인용한 하위 조문). 3단 비교는 길어서 article 로 조문을 고르는 것이 좋습니다. 약칭도 됩니다. 신구법에 edition 을 시행예정 으로 주면 아직 시행 전인 개정판이 무엇을 바꾸는지 봅니다." → after: "Compare a Korean law's articles before and after amendment (신구법), or show the Act, Enforcement Decree and Enforcement Rule side by side (3단 비교, three-tier). kind: 신구법 = old/new text of the latest amendment (changed text in 【 】); 3단 위임 = Act articles with the Decree and Rule articles they delegate to"
